evidence: The diffraction pattern of a film of GaAs grown by MLE is shown in Fig. 3, which was prepared by alternately introducing AsH3 and TMG at the inlet pressures of 7 x 10-3 and 1.3 x 10-3 Pa for a gas admittance mode (20", 1", 2", 1") at the growth temperature of 500~ A beautiful spot pattern clearly indicates the single-crystal nature of the growth film.
